nodes.label: Free Weights Area (Fixed Barbell Rack, Plate-Loaded Machines)
nodes.norm_label: free weights area (fixed barbell rack, plate-loaded machines)

nodes.label: CourageD Brand Palette (black, gold, red, white)
nodes.norm_label: couraged brand palette (black, gold, red, white)

nodes.label: CourageD Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Red blackletter-style script with white outline reading 'CouRageD'; capitalized R and D emphasise 'Rage' and 'D' within 'Courage'.

nodes.label: Fitness Couple Illustration
nodes.rationale: Gold/black high-contrast silhouette of a muscular man and a woman holding a dumbbell, signalling a gym/fitness brand.

nodes.label: Status Never Color-Only Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Badge text + icon, large touch targets, respect reduced motion.

nodes.label: Client Brand Palette (#FEBE10 gold, #BA0021 crimson, #19171B ink)
nodes.norm_label: client brand palette (#febe10 gold, #ba0021 crimson, #19171b ink)

nodes.label: Coaches (Coach Art, Coach Karl, Coach Wilmer)
nodes.norm_label: coaches (coach art, coach karl, coach wilmer)

nodes.label: Gym Membership System Prototype
nodes.rationale: Clickable sales-demo prototype; success = owner can picture running the gym on it after a 10-minute demo. No backend, seeded mock data in app state.

nodes.label: QR Check-in
nodes.rationale: Camera scanning must work over HTTPS on iPhone Safari and Android Chrome, with demo-menu fallbacks if the camera fails.

nodes.label: Stack: React + Vite + Tailwind v4, React Router, Recharts, qrcode.react, qr-scanner, anime.js, Motion, Kokonut UI, Vercel
nodes.norm_label: stack: react + vite + tailwind v4, react router, recharts, qrcode.react, qr-scanner, anime.js, motion, kokonut ui, vercel

nodes.label: Demo Never Dead-Ends Principle
nodes.rationale: Every camera/network path has a fallback because it is shown live in a pitch.

nodes.label: Deterministic Seeded Mock Data
nodes.rationale: Fixed seed keeps demo repeatable; actions update dashboards live and 'Reset demo data' restores state.

nodes.label: Glanceable First Principle
nodes.rationale: Staff read status in under a second while greeting members.

nodes.label: Placeholders Visible as Placeholders
nodes.rationale: Prices, coach specialties, about copy, year opened, member count are placeholders and must never be presented as fact to the client.

nodes.label: Real Gym Material Over Generic Chrome
nodes.norm_label: real gym material over generic chrome
nodes.rationale: Positioned as built for this one gym (logo, photos, coaches, Cebu context, peso, Filipino names), not a generic SaaS template.

nodes.label: Role Switcher (Admin / Staff / Member)
nodes.rationale: No real auth; fixed switcher lets the demo play each persona.
